# Teaching

This page is adapted from [ccgoller.com/teaching-philosophy](https://ccgoller.com/teaching-philosophy/) and [ccgoller.com/courses](https://ccgoller.com/courses/).

## Teaching Philosophy

The mysteries of nature inspire innovation and scientific discovery, but scientific literacy is essential for everyone in an interconnected world. I am committed to making science more accessible by engaging students as participants and co-creators in the learning process.

My teaching framework emphasizes discovery, collaboration, and communication: discover, teach, and share together.

## Curriculum Development

- Inquiry-driven laboratory design for biotechnology and microbiology learning.
- Integration of high-throughput and genomics approaches into undergraduate teaching.
- Open pedagogy and OER-centered curriculum innovation.
